The 2021 Cadillac Escalade was recalled for an electrical system defect in campaign [21V739000]. The defect involves the fuel pump power control module potentially causing fuel pump failure or intermittent operation, which can interrupt fuel flow and cause engine stalling. The risk is an increased crash probability due to engine stalling. The remedy is free replacement of the fuel pump power control module by dealers.

The 2017 Acura MDX was recalled due to a manufacturing error causing the connecting rod bearing in the engine to wear and seize [23V751000]. This defect risks engine malfunction, stalling, and potential fire, crash, or injury. The remedy involves free engine inspection and repair or replacement at dealerships.

The 2023 Honda Ridgeline was recalled over its body structure due to a defect in the rear suspension components. [26V365000] The defect involves the rear control arm potentially failing, which increases the risk of a crash. The remedy is dealers replacing the rear subframe with a reinforcement kit.

The 2012 Toyota Prius was recalled [16V487000] for a defect where a weld in the curtain shield air bag inflator may crack, causing one or both portions to eject into the passenger cabin. This increases injury risk to occupants. The remedy is installing retention brackets to the curtain shield air bags free of charge, starting October 17, 2016.

The 2014 GMC Acadia was recalled due to a driver's airbag inflator module defect that could explode during deployment. The risk is serious injury or death from sharp metal fragments. The remedy is replacing the driver's airbag module free of charge. [23V334000]

The 2022 Tesla Model X was recalled [22V264000] due to a body structure reinforcement bracket not being installed at the second-row seat, failing to comply with FMVSS 207 and 210. This defect increases the risk of injury during a crash as the second-row seat may not properly restrain occupants. The remedy was a free vehicle replacement completed April 28, 2022.

The 2013 Ford Escape was recalled under campaign [14V164000] for front seatback assemblies that may have been produced with substandard components. The defect causes the seatback to become loose or lean while driving, increasing injury risk in crashes. The remedy is free replacement of the seatback by dealers starting May 30, 2014.

The 2017 Jeep Cherokee was recalled [17V543000] due to missing tire and rim size information on the certification label, which could lead to an incorrect tire and rim combination being installed. This defect violates FMVSS 110 and increases crash risk. The remedy is providing a corrected certification label free of charge, starting October 13, 2017.

The 2022 Ram 2500 was recalled for a brake-related issue under campaign [22V140000]. The defect involves the ABS control module software failing to illuminate the electronic stability control (ESC) malfunction indicator light during certain conditions. This increases crash risk. The remedy is a free software update to the ABS control module.

The 2014 Volkswagen Passat was recalled over its electrical system due to improperly assembled wire seals in a connector for an underbody sensor [16V171000]. This defect allows water to enter and corrode electrical connectors, causing an electrical short. The risk is an increased fire risk from overheated electrical connectors. The remedy involves dealers inspecting and replacing the connector free of charge. The recall campaign number is 23T3.

The 2022 Hyundai Palisade was recalled for seat belt buckle defects [25V607000]. The defect involves seat belt buckles in driver, passenger, and second-row window seats failing to latch. The risk is occupants may not be properly restrained in a crash, increasing injury risk. The remedy requires inserting the belt firmly into the buckle with a quick motion to confirm security, followed by replacement of the buckle assemblies at dealerships.

The 2018 Chrysler Pacifica was recalled in two campaigns. [18V332000] addressed cruise control software issues where the vehicle might maintain speed or accelerate despite deactivating cruise control, risking a crash. The remedy was a free software flash. [18V493000] involved incorrectly assembled front axle halfshafts, risking loss of drive or movement in 'Park', with a free halfshaft replacement. Both recalls targeted 2018 Pacificas.

The 2025 Mazda CX-70 was recalled over its body structure due to a Dash Electrical Supply Unit (ESU) software issue. The defect involves the ESU software causing improper functionality of defroster, seat belt warning, 360° view monitor, and PHEV high-voltage battery cooling system during startup. The risk is an increased crash probability from these system failures. The remedy is free software reprogramming at dealerships. [24V814000]
